headline: GOLD JUMPS 2% ON SOFT JOBS DATA — $4,094 AS FED RATE HIKE BETS CRATER; SILVER RECLAIMS $60
snippet: Gold spot rose to $4,094 on Thursday, extending a two-day rebound, after softer-than-expected ADP private payrolls (98,000 vs 118,000 forecast) and Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's comments suggesting eased inflation risks drove market pricing for a September rate hike below 50% — reversing the hawkish re-pricing that had ground gold from above $5,500 in January to eight-month lows near $3,980. Silver bounced 1.8% to $60.21, with platinum (+2.6%) and palladium (+2.1%) also rising on the broad precious metals recovery.

headline: WORLD GOLD COUNCIL: GOLD STUCK NEAR $4,100 IN H2 UNLESS ECONOMY BREAKS OR GEOPOLITICS SHOCK — CENTRAL BANKS KEY
snippet: The World Gold Council's mid-year 2026 outlook, released July 1, pegs gold in a ±5% range around $4,100 for the second half under unchanged conditions — requiring a deteriorating economy, renewed geopolitical shock, or a pivot toward lower interest-rate expectations to propel a move back toward $4,500 or higher. Central banks — averaging 1,000 tonnes of purchases per year since 2022, with a record 45% surveyed planning further additions — and India, the world's second-largest gold market at ~800 tonnes per year, are identified as the two market segments capable of moving prices unilaterally.

headline: KITCO: GOLD FELL 14%, SILVER 21% IN Q2 — ENTERING Q3 ON LONG-TERM SUPPORT WITH SEASONAL TAILWIND
snippet: Kitco's July 1 market analysis argues that gold's 14% and silver's 21% Q2 corrections represent a positioning reset, not a structural breakdown: both metals are sitting on long-term technical support, and gold has a documented seasonal tendency to firm from early July into early August — a window that opens precisely as Q3 begins. Silver, which fell faster, also tends to lead recoveries, and with six consecutive years of supply deficit against rising solar, EV, and AI data-centre demand, the structural case for silver's recovery is intact. The hawkish catalyst — a changeover at the Fed and firmer June data — may now be fully priced at current levels.

headline: LI-FT POWER DRILLS 21m AT 1.09% Li₂O AT YELLOWKNIFE NWT — MULTI-DYKE SPODUMENE SYSTEM CONFIRMED (TSXV:LIFT)
snippet: Li-FT Power (TSXV:LIFT) reported June 30 drill results from 20 holes (5,324m) at its Yellowknife Lithium Project in the Northwest Territories, with standout hole YLP-0304 returning 21m at 1.09% Li₂O (including 13m at 1.38% Li₂O) at the Fi Main pegmatite, hole YLP-0320 cutting a 20m-wide dyke assaying 1.32% Li₂O over 17m, and hole YLP-0322 intersecting seven dykes totalling 33m of pegmatite — four of which are spodumene-bearing. The 2026 winter program targeted open mineralisation at depth at BIG East ahead of a preliminary economic assessment planned for 2027.

headline: BRIXTON METALS HITS 14.75m AT 1.25% Cu / 1.71 g/t Au / 149 g/t Ag AT THORN; BONANZA 8.33% Cu IN 1.5m FEEDER (TSXV:BBB)
snippet: Brixton Metals Corp. (TSXV:BBB) announced June 30 initial 2026 drill results from the Thorn Project in northwest British Columbia, with hole THN26-372 returning 14.75m of 1.25% copper, 1.71 g/t gold, and 149.0 g/t silver from 84.25m depth — including a 1.50m high-grade interval of 8.33% copper, 11.30 g/t gold, and 971 g/t silver — from the near-surface Glenfiddich Zone. Management interprets the Glenfiddich Zone as a feeder structure to the Camp Creek porphyry at depth; step-out drilling extended the zone 20m west and it remains open along strike and down-dip.

headline: TRUMP LOCKS IN PHASED REFINED COPPER TARIFF — 15% JAN 2027, 30% JAN 2028; COMEX HITS 650,000-TON RECORD
snippet: The U.S. Commerce Department submitted its Section 232 copper market report to the White House on June 30, and President Trump signed an executive order locking in a phased tariff on imported refined copper: 15% from January 1, 2027, rising to 30% from January 1, 2028. COMEX copper inventories surged to a record 650,000 tonnes ahead of the policy trigger as traders front-ran the framework; Goldman Sachs expects copper prices to breach $14,000 per tonne once the tariffs take effect. The framework excludes raw copper ores, concentrates, and cathodes — limiting direct impact on most TSX/TSXV copper producers, which primarily export unrefined material.

headline: SOUTHERN SILVER CHANNELS 2.8m AT 757 g/t AgEq AT PURO CORAZON MINE — FIRST ASSAYS FROM 14-SUBLEVEL MAPPING (TSXV:SSV)
source_name: Yahoo Finance / Southern Silver Exploration Corp. (TSXV:SSV)
snippet: Southern Silver Exploration Corp. (TSXV:SSV) reported July 2 the first underground channel sampling assays from its Puro Corazon Mine at the Cerro Las Minitas property in Durango, Mexico, returning 2.8m at 757 g/t AgEq and 3.2m at 479 g/t AgEq from Level 4 of 14 sublevels — part of a systematic underground mapping and geotechnical program designed to establish mineralisation continuity between near-surface workings and recent drill intercepts. Deeper levels are pending in a follow-up release.

headline: MITHRIL UPGRADES COPALQUIN TARGET 1 TO 615K oz AuEq — 75% NOW INDICATED AFTER 60,000m OF DRILLING (TSXV:MSG)
source_name: Newsfilecorp / Mithril Silver and Gold Ltd. (TSXV:MSG)
snippet: Mithril Silver and Gold Ltd. (TSXV:MSG, ASX:MTH) announced an updated NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate for the Target 1 deposit at its Copalquin Project in Durango, Mexico (effective June 29, 2026): 615,000 oz AuEq total — 464,000 oz AuEq Indicated (3.39 Mt at 3.15 g/t Au and 77.8 g/t Ag) and 151,000 oz AuEq Inferred (1.44 Mt at 2.23 g/t Au and 73.6 g/t Ag), representing a 196% increase in higher-confidence Indicated ounces. The company is fully funded for 12,000 additional metres of 2026 drilling targeting a maiden resource at Target 5 and expansion of Target 1.

headline: ARGENTA SILVER DEFINES 20+ TARGETS AT EL QUEVAR — MANI-COPAN 500m × 90m FOOTPRINT; PEA DATA DUE Q3 (TSXV:AGAG)
snippet: Argenta Silver Corp. (TSXV:AGAG) reported June 30 a surface exploration update on its El Quevar flagship project in Salta Province, Argentina, identifying 20+ priority targets across Quevar South, North, and Azufre through a 720+ km regional magnetic survey that is 89% complete. The Mani-Copan target — showing a 500m × 90m mineralized footprint with high-grade silver confirmed at surface and the same geochemical signature as the Yaxtché Deposit — is the most advanced. Metallurgical test work from 27 drill holes is expected by Q3 2026, feeding into an updated resource model.
